description: This Java source file defines an abstract class for widget condition models and various concrete condition classes used for evaluating conditions based on XML configuration in the OFBiz framework. It includes condition factories, reflection-based validation, permission checks, regex matching, and logical operators.

classes.name: ModelWidgetCondition
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a read-only condition model for widget XML configuration, supporting evaluation and sub-condition reading.

classes.name: Condition
classes.description: Interface defining the eval method for condition evaluation.

classes.name: ConditionFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating Condition instances from XML elements.

classes.name: DefaultConditionFactory
classes.description: Default implementation of ConditionFactory, creating specific condition objects based on XML node names.

classes.name: And
classes.description: Represents a logical AND condition composed of multiple sub-conditions.

classes.name: Or
classes.description: Represents a logical OR condition composed of multiple sub-conditions.

classes.name: Xor
classes.description: Represents a logical XOR condition with multiple sub-conditions.

classes.name: Not
classes.description: Represents a logical NOT condition wrapping a single sub-condition.

classes.name: IfCompare
classes.description: Condition that compares a field value to a specified value using an operator.

classes.name: IfCompareField
classes.description: Condition that compares two fields' values using an operator.

classes.name: IfEmpty
classes.description: Condition that checks if a specified field is empty.

classes.name: IfEntityPermission
classes.description: Condition that checks entity permissions using EntityPermissionChecker.

classes.name: IfHasPermission
classes.description: Condition that checks if the user has a specific permission or entity permission.

classes.name: IfRegexp
classes.description: Condition that matches a field's string value against a regex pattern.

classes.name: IfServicePermission
classes.description: Condition that checks service-based permissions via a service call.

classes.name: IfValidateMethod
classes.description: Condition that invokes a static validation method via reflection.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the condition against a given context map.

methods.name: readSubConditions
methods.description: Reads and constructs a list of sub-conditions from XML child elements.
